verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ رَنَّمَ مُوسَى وَبَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ هَذِهِ ٱلتَّسْبِيحَةَ لِلرَّبِّ وَقَالُوا: «أُرَنِّمُ لِلرَّبِّ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ تَعَظَّمَ. ٱلْفَرَسَ وَرَاكِبَهُ طَرَحَهُمَا فِي ٱلْبَحْرِ.
verses.kjv: Then sang Moses and the children of Israel this song unto the LORD, and spake, saying, I will sing unto the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously: the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verses.web: Then Moses and the children of Israel sang this song to Yahweh, and said, “I will sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.
verses.he: אָ֣ז יָשִֽׁיר־מֹשֶׁה֩ וּבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אֶת־הַשִּׁירָ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֵאמֹ֑ר אָשִׁ֤ירָה לֽ͏ַיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְרֹכְבֹ֖ו רָמָ֥ה בַיָּֽם׃

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ قُوَّتِي وَنَشِيدِي، وَقَدْ صَارَ خَلَاصِي. هَذَا إِلَهِي فَأُمَجِّدُهُ، إِلَهُ أَبِي فَأُرَفِّعُهُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] my strength and song, and he is become my salvation: he [is] my God, and I will prepare him an habitation; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
verses.web: Yah is my strength and song. He has become my salvation. This is my God, and I will praise him; my father’s God, and I will exalt him.
verses.he: עָזִּ֤י וְזִמְרָת֙ יָ֔הּ וַֽיְהִי־לִ֖י לִֽישׁוּעָ֑ה זֶ֤ה אֵלִי֙ וְאַנְוֵ֔הוּ אֱלֹהֵ֥י אָבִ֖י וַאֲרֹמְמֶֽנְהוּ׃

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ رَجُلُ ٱلْحَرْبِ. ٱلرَّبُّ ٱسْمُهُ.
verses.kjv: The LORD [is] a man of war: the LORD [is] his name.
verses.web: Yahweh is a man of war. Yahweh is his name.
verses.he: יְהוָ֖ה אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֑ה יְהוָ֖ה שְׁמֹֽו׃

verses.ar: مَرْكَبَاتُ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَيْشُهُ أَلْقَاهُمَا فِي ٱلْبَحْرِ، فَغَرِقَ أَفْضَلُ جُنُودِهِ ٱلْمَرْكَبِيَّةِ فِي بَحْرِ سُوفَ،
verses.kjv: Pharaoh’s chariots and his host hath he cast into the sea: his chosen captains also are drowned in the Red sea.
verses.web: He has cast Pharaoh’s chariots and his army into the sea. His chosen captains are sunk in the Red Sea.
verses.he: מַרְכְּבֹ֥ת פַּרְעֹ֛ה וְחֵילֹ֖ו יָרָ֣ה בַיָּ֑ם וּמִבְחַ֥ר שָֽׁלִשָׁ֖יו טֻבְּע֥וּ בְיַם־סֽוּף׃

verses.ar: تُغَطِّيهِمُ ٱللُّجَجُ. قَدْ هَبَطُوا فِي ٱلْأَعْمَاقِ كَحَجَرٍ.
verses.kjv: The depths have covered them: they sank into the bottom as a stone.
verses.web: The deeps cover them. They went down into the depths like a stone.
verses.he: תְּהֹמֹ֖ת יְכַסְיֻ֑מוּ יָרְד֥וּ בִמְצֹולֹ֖ת כְּמֹו־אָֽבֶן׃

verses.ar: يَمِينُكَ يَا رَبُّ مُعْتَزَّةٌ بِٱلْقُدْرَةِ. يَمِينُكَ يَا رَبُّ تُحَطِّمُ ٱلْعَدُوَّ.
verses.kjv: Thy right hand, O LORD, is become glorious in power: thy right hand, O LORD, hath dashed in pieces the enemy.
verses.web: Your right hand, Yahweh, is glorious in power. Your right hand, Yahweh, dashes the enemy in pieces.
verses.he: יְמִֽינְךָ֣ יְהוָ֔ה נֶאְדָּרִ֖י בַּכֹּ֑חַ יְמִֽינְךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה תִּרְעַ֥ץ אֹויֵֽב׃

verses.ar: وَبِكَثْرَةِ عَظَمَتِكَ تَهْدِمُ مُقَاوِمِيكَ. تُرْسِلُ سُخْطَكَ فَيَأْكُلُهُمْ كَٱلْقَشِّ،
verses.kjv: And in the greatness of thine excellency thou hast overthrown them that rose up against thee: thou sentest forth thy wrath, [which] consumed them as stubble.
verses.web: In the greatness of your excellency, you overthrow those who rise up against you. You send out your wrath. It consumes them as stubble.
verses.he: וּבְרֹ֥ב גְּאֹונְךָ֖ תַּהֲרֹ֣ס קָמֶ֑יךָ תְּשַׁלַּח֙ חֲרֹ֣נְךָ֔ יֹאכְלֵ֖מֹו כַּקַּֽשׁ׃

verses.ar: وَبِرِيحِ أَنْفِكَ تَرَاكَمَتِ ٱلْمِيَاهُ. ٱنْتَصَبَتِ ٱلْمَجَارِيَ كَرَابِيَةٍ. تَجَمَّدَتِ ٱللُّجَجُ فِي قَلْبِ ٱلْبَحْرِ.
verses.kjv: And with the blast of thy nostrils the waters were gathered together, the floods stood upright as an heap, [and] the depths were congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.web: With the blast of your nostrils, the waters were piled up. The floods stood upright as a heap. The deeps were congealed in the heart of the sea.
verses.he: וּבְר֤וּחַ אַפֶּ֙יךָ֙ נֶ֣עֶרְמוּ מַ֔יִם נִצְּב֥וּ כְמֹו־נֵ֖ד נֹזְלִ֑ים קָֽפְא֥וּ תְהֹמֹ֖ת בְּלֶב־יָֽם׃

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلْعَدُوُّ: أَتْبَعُ، أُدْرِكُ، أُقَسِّمُ غَنِيمَةً. تَمْتَلِئُ مِنْهُمْ نَفْسِي. أُجَرِّدُ سَيْفِي. تُفْنِيهِمْ يَدِي.
verses.kjv: The enemy said, I will pursue, I will overtake, I will divide the spoil; my lust shall be satisfied upon them; I will draw my sword, my hand shall destroy them.
verses.web: The enemy said, ‘I will pursue. I will overtake. I will divide the plunder. My desire will be satisfied on them. I will draw my sword. My hand will destroy them.’
verses.he: אָמַ֥ר אֹויֵ֛ב אֶרְדֹּ֥ף אַשִּׂ֖יג אֲחַלֵּ֣ק שָׁלָ֑ל תִּמְלָאֵ֣מֹו נַפְשִׁ֔י אָרִ֣יק חַרְבִּ֔י תֹּורִישֵׁ֖מֹו יָדִֽי׃

verses.ar: نَفَخْتَ بِرِيحِكَ فَغَطَّاهُمُ ٱلْبَحْرُ. غَاصُوا كَٱلرَّصَاصِ فِي مِيَاهٍ غَامِرَةٍ.
verses.kjv: Thou didst blow with thy wind, the sea covered them: they sank as lead in the mighty waters.
verses.web: You blew with your wind. The sea covered them. They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
verses.he: נָשַׁ֥פְתָּ בְרוּחֲךָ֖ כִּסָּ֣מֹו יָ֑ם צָֽלֲלוּ֙ כַּֽעֹופֶ֔רֶת בְּמַ֖יִם אַדִּירִֽים׃

verses.ar: مَنْ مِثْلُكَ بَيْنَ ٱلْآلِهَةِ يَا رَبُّ؟ مَنْ مِثْلُكَ مُعْتَزًّا فِي ٱلْقَدَاسَةِ، مَخُوفًا بِٱلتَّسَابِيحِ، صَانِعًا عَجَائِبَ؟
verses.kjv: Who [is] like unto thee, O LORD, among the gods? who [is] like thee, glorious in holiness, fearful [in] praises, doing wonders?
verses.web: Who is like you, Yahweh, among the gods? Who is like you, glorious in holiness, fearful in praises, doing wonders?
verses.he: מִֽי־כָמֹ֤כָה בָּֽאֵלִם֙ יְהוָ֔ה מִ֥י כָּמֹ֖כָה נֶאְדָּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ נֹורָ֥א תְהִלֹּ֖ת עֹ֥שֵׂה פֶֽלֶא׃

verses.ar: تَمُدُّ يَمِينَكَ فَتَبْتَلِعُهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ.
verses.kjv: Thou stretchedst out thy right hand, the earth swallowed them.
verses.web: You stretched out your right hand. The earth swallowed them.
verses.he: נָטִ֙יתָ֙ יְמִ֣ינְךָ֔ תִּבְלָעֵ֖מֹו אָֽרֶץ׃

verses.ar: تُرْشِدُ بِرَأْفَتِكَ ٱلشَّعْبَ ٱلَّذِي فَدَيْتَهُ. تَهْدِيهِ بِقُوَّتِكَ إِلَى مَسْكَنِ قُدْسِكَ.
verses.kjv: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people [ which] thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided [them] in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
verses.web: “You, in your loving kindness, have led the people that you have redeemed. You have guided them in your strength to your holy habitation.
verses.he: נָחִ֥יתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ֖ עַם־ז֣וּ גָּאָ֑לְתָּ נֵהַ֥לְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ֖ אֶל־נְוֵ֥ה קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃

verses.ar: يَسْمَعُ ٱلشُّعُوبُ فَيَرْتَعِدُونَ. تَأْخُذُ ٱلرَّعْدَةُ سُكَّانَ فِلِسْطِينَ.
verses.kjv: The people shall hear, [and] be afraid: sorrow shall take hold on the inhabitants of Palestina.
verses.web: The peoples have heard. They tremble. Pangs have taken hold of the inhabitants of Philistia.
verses.he: שָֽׁמְע֥וּ עַמִּ֖ים יִרְגָּז֑וּן חִ֣יל אָחַ֔ז יֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּלָֽשֶׁת׃

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ يَنْدَهِشُ أُمَرَاءُ أَدُومَ. أَقْوِيَاءُ مُوآبَ تَأْخُذُهُمُ ٱلرَّجْفَةُ. يَذُوبُ جَمِيعُ سُكَّانِ كَنْعَانَ.
verses.kjv: Then the dukes of Edom shall be amazed; the mighty men of Moab, trembling shall take hold upon them; all the inhabitants of Canaan shall melt away.
verses.web: Then the chiefs of Edom were dismayed. Trembling takes hold of the mighty men of Moab. All the inhabitants of Canaan have melted away.
verses.he: אָ֤ז נִבְהֲלוּ֙ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱדֹ֔ום אֵילֵ֣י מֹואָ֔ב יֹֽאחֲזֵ֖מֹו רָ֑עַד נָמֹ֕גוּ כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י כְנָֽעַן׃

verses.ar: تَقَعُ عَلَيْهِمِ ٱلْهَيْبَةُ وَٱلرُّعْبُ. بِعَظَمَةِ ذِرَاعِكَ يَصْمُتُونَ كَٱلْحَجَرِ حَتَّى يَعْبُرَ شَعْبُكَ يَا رَبُّ. حَتَّى يَعْبُرَ ٱلشَّعْبُ ٱلَّذِي ٱقْتَنَيْتَهُ.
verses.kjv: Fear and dread shall fall upon them; by the greatness of thine arm they shall be [as] still as a stone; till thy people pass over, O LORD, till the people pass over, [ which] thou hast purchased.
verses.web: Terror and dread falls on them. By the greatness of your arm they are as still as a stone, until your people pass over, Yahweh, until the people you have purchased pass over.
verses.he: תִּפֹּ֨ל עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם אֵימָ֙תָה֙ וָפַ֔חַד בִּגְדֹ֥ל זְרֹועֲךָ֖ יִדְּמ֣וּ כָּאָ֑בֶן עַד־יַעֲבֹ֤ר עַמְּךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה עַֽד־יַעֲבֹ֖ר עַם־ז֥וּ קָנִֽיתָ׃

verses.ar: تَجِيءُ بِهِمْ وَتَغْرِسُهُمْ فِي جَبَلِ مِيرَاثِكَ، ٱلْمَكَانِ ٱلَّذِي صَنَعْتَهُ يَا رَبُّ لِسَكَنِكَ ٱلْمَقْدِسِ ٱلَّذِي هَيَّأَتْهُ يَدَاكَ يَا رَبُّ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thine inheritance, [in] the place, O LORD, [which] thou hast made for thee to dwell in, [in] the Sanctuary, O Lord, [which] thy hands have established.
verses.web: You will bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of your inheritance, the place, Yahweh, which you have made for yourself to dwell in: the sanctuary, Lord, which your hands have established.
verses.he: תְּבִאֵ֗מֹו וְתִטָּעֵ֙מֹו֙ בְּהַ֣ר נַחֲלָֽתְךָ֔ מָכֹ֧ון לְשִׁבְתְּךָ֛ פָּעַ֖לְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה מִקְּדָ֕שׁ אֲדֹנָ֖י כֹּונְנ֥וּ יָדֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ يَمْلِكُ إِلَى ٱلدَّهْرِ وَٱلْأَبَدِ».
verses.kjv: The LORD shall reign for ever and ever.
verses.web: Yahweh will reign forever and ever.”
verses.he: יְהוָ֥ה ׀ יִמְלֹ֖ךְ לְעֹלָ֥ם וָעֶֽד׃

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ خَيْلَ فِرْعَوْنَ دَخَلَتْ بِمَرْكَبَاتِهِ وَفُرْسَانِهِ إِلَى ٱلْبَحْرِ، وَرَدَّ ٱلرَّبُّ عَلَيْهِمْ مَاءَ ٱلْبَحْرِ. وَأَمَّا بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ فَمَشَوْا عَلَى ٱلْيَابِسَةِ فِي وَسَطِ ٱلْبَحْرِ.
verses.kjv: For the horse of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and the LORD brought again the waters of the sea upon them; but the children of Israel went on dry [land] in the midst of the sea.
verses.web: For the horses of Pharaoh went in with his chariots and with his horsemen into the sea, and Yahweh brought back the waters of the sea on them; but the children of Israel walked on dry land in the middle of the sea.
verses.he: כִּ֣י בָא֩ ס֨וּס פַּרְעֹ֜ה בְּרִכְבֹּ֤ו וּבְפָרָשָׁיו֙ בַּיָּ֔ם וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵהֶ֖ם אֶת־מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָלְכ֥וּ בַיַּבָּשָׁ֖ה בְּתֹ֥וךְ הַיָּֽם׃ פ

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَتْ مَرْيَمُ ٱلنَّبِيَّةُ أُخْتُ هَارُونَ ٱلدُّفَّ بِيَدِهَا، وَخَرَجَتْ جَمِيعُ ٱلنِّسَاءِ وَرَاءَهَا بِدُفُوفٍ وَرَقْصٍ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a timbrel in her hand; and all the women went out after her with timbrels and with dances.
verses.web: Miriam the prophetess, the sister of Aaron, took a tambourine in her hand; and all the women went out after her with tambourines and with dances.
verses.he: וַתִּקַּח֩ מִרְיָ֨ם הַנְּבִיאָ֜ה אֲחֹ֧ות אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת־הַתֹּ֖ף בְּיָדָ֑הּ וַתֵּצֶ֤אןָ כָֽל־הַנָּשִׁים֙ אַחֲרֶ֔יהָ בְּתֻפִּ֖ים וּבִמְחֹלֹֽת׃

verses.ar: وَأَجَابَتْهُمْ مَرْيَمُ: «رَنِّمُوا لِلرَّبِّ فَإِنَّهُ قَدْ تَعَظَّمَ. ٱلْفَرَسَ وَرَاكِبَهُ طَرَحَهُمَا فِي ٱلْبَحْرِ».
verses.kjv: And Miriam answered them, Sing ye to the LORD, for he hath triumphed gloriously; the horse and his rider hath he thrown into the sea.
verses.web: Miriam answered them, “Sing to Yahweh, for he has triumphed gloriously. He has thrown the horse and his rider into the sea.”
verses.he: וַתַּ֥עַן לָהֶ֖ם מִרְיָ֑ם שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ כִּֽי־גָאֹ֣ה גָּאָ֔ה ס֥וּס וְרֹכְבֹ֖ו רָמָ֥ה בַיָּֽם׃ ס

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ٱرْتَحَلَ مُوسَى بِإِسْرَائِيلَ مِنْ بَحْرِ سُوفَ وَخَرَجُوا إِلَى بَرِّيَّةِ شُورٍ. فَسَارُوا ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فِي ٱلْبَرِّيَّةِ وَلَمْ يَجِدُوا مَاءً.
verses.kjv: So Moses brought Israel from the Red sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
verses.web: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
verses.he: וַיַּסַּ֨ע מֹשֶׁ֤ה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִיַּם־ס֔וּף וַיֵּצְא֖וּ אֶל־מִדְבַּר־שׁ֑וּר וַיֵּלְכ֧וּ שְׁלֹֽשֶׁת־יָמִ֛ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֖ר וְלֹא־מָ֥צְאוּ מָֽיִם׃

verses.ar: فَجَاءُوا إِلَى مَارَّةَ، وَلَمْ يَقْدِرُوا أَنْ يَشْرَبُوا مَاءً مِنْ مَارَّةَ لِأَنَّهُ مُرٌّ. لِذَلِكَ دُعِيَ ٱسْمُهَا «مَارَّةَ».
verses.kjv: ¶ And when they came to Marah, they could not drink of the waters of Marah, for they [were] bitter: therefore the name of it was called Marah.
verses.web: When they came to Marah, they couldn’t drink from the waters of Marah, for they were bitter. Therefore its name was called Marah.
verses.he: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ מָרָ֔תָה וְלֹ֣א יָֽכְל֗וּ לִשְׁתֹּ֥ת מַ֙יִם֙ מִמָּרָ֔ה כִּ֥י מָרִ֖ים הֵ֑ם עַל־כֵּ֥ן קָרָֽא־שְׁמָ֖הּ מָרָֽה׃

verses.ar: فَتَذَمَّرَ ٱلشَّعْبُ عَلَى مُوسَى قَائِلِينَ: «مَاذَا نَشْرَبُ؟»
verses.kjv: And the people murmured against Moses, saying, What shall we drink?
verses.web: The people murmured against Moses, saying, “What shall we drink?”
verses.he: וַיִּלֹּ֧נוּ הָעָ֛ם עַל־מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹ֖ר מַה־נִּשְׁתֶּֽה׃

verses.ar: فَصَرَخَ إِلَى ٱلرَّبِّ. فَأَرَاهُ ٱلرَّبُّ شَجَرَةً فَطَرَحَهَا فِي ٱلْمَاءِ فَصَارَ ٱلْمَاءُ عَذْبًا. هُنَاكَ وَضَعَ لَهُ فَرِيضَةً وَحُكْمًا، وَهُنَاكَ ٱمْتَحَنَهُ.
verses.kjv: And he cried unto the LORD; and the LORD shewed him a tree, [which] when he had cast into the waters, the waters were made sweet: there he made for them a statute and an ordinance, and there he proved them,
verses.web: Then he cried to Yahweh. Yahweh showed him a tree, and he threw it into the waters, and the waters were made sweet. There he made a statute and an ordinance for them, and there he tested them.
verses.he: וַיִּצְעַ֣ק אֶל־יְהוָ֗ה וַיֹּורֵ֤הוּ יְהוָה֙ עֵ֔ץ וַיַּשְׁלֵךְ֙ אֶל־הַמַּ֔יִם וַֽיִּמְתְּק֖וּ הַמָּ֑יִם שָׁ֣ם שָׂ֥ם לֹ֛ו חֹ֥ק וּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט וְשָׁ֥ם נִסָּֽהוּ׃

verses.ar: فَقَالَ: «إِنْ كُنْتَ تَسْمَعُ لِصَوْتِ ٱلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكَ، وَتَصْنَعُ ٱلْحَقَّ فِي عَيْنَيْهِ، وَتَصْغَى إِلَى وَصَايَاهُ وَتَحْفَظُ جَمِيعَ فَرَائِضِهِ، فَمَرَضًا مَا مِمَّا وَضَعْتُهُ عَلَى ٱلْمِصْرِيِّينَ لَا أَضَعُ عَلَيْكَ. فَإِنِّي أَنَا ٱلرَّبُّ شَافِيكَ».
verses.kjv: And said, If thou wilt diligently hearken to the voice of the LORD thy God, and wilt do that which is right in his sight, and wilt give ear to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of these diseases upon thee, which I have brought upon the Egyptians: for I [am] the LORD that healeth thee.
verses.web: He said, “If you will diligently listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, and will do that which is right in his eyes, and will pay attention to his commandments, and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have put on the Egyptians; for I am Yahweh who heals you.”
verses.he: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אִם־שָׁמֹ֨ועַ תִּשְׁמַ֜ע לְקֹ֣ול ׀ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ וְהַיָּשָׁ֤ר בְּעֵינָיו֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה וְהֽ͏ַאֲזַנְתָּ֙ לְמִצְוֹתָ֔יו וְשָׁמַרְתָּ֖ כָּל־חֻקָּ֑יו כָּֽל־הַמּֽ͏ַחֲלָ֞ה אֲשֶׁר־שַׂ֤מְתִּי בְמִצְרַ֙יִם֙ לֹא־אָשִׂ֣ים עָלֶ֔יךָ כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה רֹפְאֶֽךָ׃ ס

verses.ar: ثُمَّ جَاءُوا إِلَى إِيلِيمَ وَهُنَاكَ ٱثْنَتَا عَشْرَةَ عَيْنَ مَاءٍ وَسَبْعُونَ نَخْلَةً. فَنَزَلُوا هُنَاكَ عِنْدَ ٱلْمَاءِ.
verses.kjv: ¶ And they came to Elim, where [were] twelve wells of water, and threescore and ten palm trees: and they encamped there by the waters.
verses.web: They came to Elim, where there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees. They encamped there by the waters.
verses.he: וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ אֵילִ֔מָה וְשָׁ֗ם שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֛ה עֵינֹ֥ת מַ֖יִם וְשִׁבְעִ֣ים תְּמָרִ֑ים וַיַּחֲנוּ־שָׁ֖ם עַל־הַמָּֽיִם׃
